Q: How to notify a (Spring4D) TObjectDataSet when a bound object property has changed A:

The relevant steps are the following:

  • the class of the objects in the list need to implement Spring.INotifyPropertyChanged but not be reference counted - best to inherit them from Spring.TInterfaceBase
  • the list needs to be an observable list - create those via Spring.Collections.TCollections.CreateObservableList
  • the ObjectDataSet needs to have TrackChanges := True

Q: How to Re-publish Web App without changing URL A:

Quick steps for googlers like me

  1. Save code edits.
  2. At the top, click Deploy > Manage deployments.
  3. Select the deployment and click Edit.
  4. In the "version" drop down, select new version of the code (that was the main trick).
  5. Click deploy. Changes now took effect for the same url.

Steps might be indeed unintuitive

Q: get or set inexistant properties of Powershell object A:

That's not exactly what happens. If you use $h | gm you won't see a new property. $h.a is shorthand for $h["a"], just syntactic sugar.

PowerShell is built on top of .NET, which is strongly typed. PowerShell does offer several ways to extend types though, beyond what's offered by .NET itself.

The HashTable class is a .NET type and doesn't allow adding properties. If you tried the same thing with another .NET type for which there are no shortcuts, eg a FileInfo object, you'd get an error

$A = Get-ChildItem C:\tools\
$A.x="xxxx"
---
InvalidOperation: The property 'x' cannot be found on this object.

On the other hand, ADUser and PSObject are Dynamic Objects which do allow adding actual properties and methods to the object. PSObject implements the IDynamicMetaObjectProvider interface directly.

The ADUser object implements that interface because the actual data in an AD object can be arbitrary. The object's class specifies some required properties but those can be extended. Making that object dynamic allows exposing and modifying those properties. Modifications aren't applied to the actual AD object directly. They're cached until they're persisted with Set-ADUser.

You can add properties to objects that aren't dynamic by adding a Note Property using Add-Member. This property is available in the script but doesn't modify the actual object, eg the file. In the doc example, the actual file doesn't get a new Status property

$A = Get-ChildItem C:\ps-test\test.txt
$A | Add-Member -NotePropertyName Status -NotePropertyValue Done
$A.Status

Let's say you want to find duplicate files. One way to do it is to calculate a hash for each file and attach it to a FileInfo as a Hash Note property. After that, you can group the objects by Hash and check which groups have Count > 1

Q: How to get "unique" rows in a Google Sheets QUERY(), ignoring a specific column when factoring uniqueness? A:

To get all routes by distance, retaining duplicates where only the date and distance differ, but leaving only the latest copy of each route by date, use sortn():

=sortn('unsorted raw data'!A1:E, 15, 2, 5, false, 2, true, 3, true, 4, true)

To weed out duplicate distances as well, use aggregation in the query statement, like this:

=query(
  'Mileage 2026'!A1:E, 
  "select max(A), B, C, D, max(E) 
   group by B, C, D
   order by max(E) desc 
   limit 10",
  1
)

Note that this will mix row data slightly, as the result will show the latest date and the longest distance that appear with the same B, C, D combo, even if that latest date and longest distance are from different rows in the data.

To avoid that, group by distance as well, use sortn() to only get the first instance of rows where B, C, D are duplicates, and finally use sort() to order by distance descending.

=sort(
  sortn(
    query(
      'Mileage 2026'!A2:E, 
      "select max(A), B, C, D, E
       group by B, C, D, E
       order by E desc
       label max(A) '' ",
      0
    ),
    10, 2, 2, true, 3, true, 4, true
  ),
  5, false
)

You can drop the outer sort if ordering by distance is not required.

See sortn() and query().

Q: Android Play Game Services publishing vs testing problems A:

You don't need to "release" [edited] your game in order for testers to try out your game. One reason you may get the "I have to publish the Game Services first..." is because you most likely did not complete the Game Services and API setup between Google Play Developer Console and the app itself.

See steps:

https://developers.google.com/games/services/console/enabling#a_create_a_linked_application

Or, less likely, it could be that you still need to upload the APK:

Upload an Alpha or Beta APK, wait a few hours for it to become active in the system, and then add your tester group. This is a good place to start as of the date of my post:

https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/3131213

Some details from the link above:

Set up alpha/beta tests

Using the Google Play Developer Console, you can choose groups of users to beta test different versions of your app.

Testing basics

With the alpha/beta testing tools available in your Developer account, you can test different versions of your app.

  • You don't need a production APK to publish an alpha/beta app.
  • Users need a Google Account (@gmail.com) or a Google Apps account to join a test.
  • If you're testing an existing app that you've published before, only users in your test group will receive an update for your alpha/beta version. If you're testing a new app that you haven't published before, only users in your test group can find and download your app.
  • After publishing an alpha/beta APK for the first time, it may take a few hours for your test link to be available to testers. If you publish additional changes, they may take several hours to be available for testers.
  • If you make any changes to your app's Pricing & Distribution page, including setting your app price to Paid or Free, it affects your production, alpha, beta, and any future versions of your app.

Tip: When you're starting a new alpha/beta test, it's a good idea to start with a small group of alpha testers, then expand your test to a larger beta test group.

Definitely make sure to see more at the provided link: https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/3131213
